Original Career

The biggest Football Legacy save. Every major system stays active, with a live month-by-month calendar at the top of Home that fills with scores, result colours and your goal contributions as the full simulation progresses.

Career Express

18–30 MIN • TRUE MIDPOINT

The proper middle option. Its Home screen is built around an instant month simulator: tap once, the whole month happens, then inspect every score, result colour and your goals/assists before moving on.

✓Full match, squad and player-development systems
✓World, Inbox and Objectives stay active
✓Lifestyle and social-message micromanagement removed
✓One-tap month simulation with every result shown
